"""One application-owned orchestration boundary for the unified KWP flow.

The orchestrator is intentionally small: it plans and gates stage execution,
but it does not contain MATLAB/Python calculation code, network clients, or
filesystem deletion.  Domain adapters register one explicit stage owner and
must return a verified :class:`~kwp_platform.artifacts.ArtifactRef`.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from collections.abc import Callable, Mapping
from dataclasses import dataclass, replace
from enum import StrEnum
from typing import Any

from .artifacts import ArtifactKind, ArtifactRef, ArtifactState, ProjectManifest, validate_handoff
from .pipeline import PipelinePlan, StageReadiness, StageSpec, build_default_pipeline_plan


class RunStatus(StrEnum):
    PLANNED = "planned"
    RUNNING = "running"
    WAITING_FOR_DATA = "waiting_for_data"
    WAITING_FOR_USER = "waiting_for_user"
    PARTIAL = "partial"
    RECOVERING = "recovering"
    STALE = "stale"
    CANCELED = "canceled"
    COMPLETED = "completed"
    FAILED = "failed"


class StageBlockedError(RuntimeError):
    """The requested stage is not admitted by the current artifact graph."""

    def __init__(self, readiness: StageReadiness) -> None:
        self.readiness = readiness
        super().__init__("stage is not ready: " + "; ".join(readiness.blocked_reasons))


class ApplicationStateError(RuntimeError):
    """The application lifecycle state does not admit the requested action."""


class AdapterNotRegisteredError(RuntimeError):
    """No explicit domain adapter owns the requested stage."""


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class StageContext:
    project_id: str
    stage: StageSpec
    inputs: Mapping[ArtifactKind, ArtifactRef]
    configuration: Mapping[str, Any]


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class StageRunResult:
    stage_id: str
    status: RunStatus
    output: ArtifactRef | None = None
    reason: str | None = None
    invocation_id: str | None = None


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class AdapterInvocationReceipt:
    """Secret-free evidence for one application-owned adapter invocation."""

    invocation_id: str
    project_id: str
    stage_id: str
    implementation_id: str
    source_owner: str
    entrypoint: str
    input_artifact_ids: tuple[str, ...]
    source_snapshot_ids: tuple[str, ...]
    output_artifact_id: str | None
    output_kind: str | None
    status: RunStatus
    reason: str | None = None

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "entrypoint": self.entrypoint,
            "implementation_id": self.implementation_id,
            "input_artifact_ids": list(self.input_artifact_ids),
            "invocation_id": self.invocation_id,
            "output_artifact_id": self.output_artifact_id,
            "output_kind": self.output_kind,
            "project_id": self.project_id,
            "reason": self.reason,
            "source_owner": self.source_owner,
            "source_snapshot_ids": list(self.source_snapshot_ids),
            "stage_id": self.stage_id,
            "status": self.status.value,
        }


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class ApplicationSnapshot:
    """A durable-UI-safe projection of one application lifecycle checkpoint."""

    project_id: str
    status: RunStatus
    completed_stages: tuple[str, ...]
    readiness: tuple[StageReadiness, ...]
    results: tuple[StageRunResult, ...]
    adapter_invocations: tuple[AdapterInvocationReceipt, ...] = ()
    stale_artifact_ids: tuple[str, ...] = ()

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "project_id": self.project_id,
            "status": self.status.value,
            "completed_stages": list(self.completed_stages),
            "readiness": [item.to_dict() for item in self.readiness],
            "results": [
                {
                    "invocation_id": item.invocation_id,
                    "stage_id": item.stage_id,
                    "status": item.status.value,
                    "reason": item.reason,
                    "artifact_id": item.output.artifact_id if item.output else None,
                }
                for item in self.results
            ],
            "adapter_invocations": [item.to_dict() for item in self.adapter_invocations],
            "stale_artifact_ids": list(self.stale_artifact_ids),
        }


StageAdapter = Callable[[StageContext], ArtifactRef]


class KwpApplication:
    """The single application owner consumed by UI and CLI adapters."""

    def __init__(
        self,
        manifest: ProjectManifest,
        *,
        plan: PipelinePlan | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        self.manifest = manifest
        self.plan = plan or build_default_pipeline_plan(manifest)
        if self.plan.project_id != manifest.project_id:
            raise ValueError("pipeline plan project does not match project manifest")
        self._artifacts: dict[ArtifactKind, ArtifactRef] = {
            ArtifactKind.PROJECT_MANIFEST: manifest.to_ref()
        }
        self._completed: set[str] = set()
        self._adapters: dict[str, StageAdapter] = {}
        self._adapter_metadata: dict[str, Mapping[str, str]] = {}
        self._results: dict[str, StageRunResult] = {}
        self._adapter_invocations: list[AdapterInvocationReceipt] = []
        # Stale outputs remain inspectable for audit/recovery, but are kept
        # outside the active artifact map so a resumed run cannot accidentally
        # consume them as verified inputs.
        self._stale_artifacts: dict[ArtifactKind, ArtifactRef] = {}
        self._stale_reason: str | None = None
        self.status = RunStatus.PLANNED

    @property
    def artifacts(self) -> Mapping[ArtifactKind, ArtifactRef]:
        return dict(self._artifacts)

    @property
    def completed_stages(self) -> tuple[str, ...]:
        return tuple(sorted(self._completed))

    @property
    def results(self) -> tuple[StageRunResult, ...]:
        return tuple(self._results[stage_id] for stage_id in sorted(self._results))

    @property
    def adapter_invocations(self) -> tuple[AdapterInvocationReceipt, ...]:
        return tuple(self._adapter_invocations)

    @property
    def stale_artifacts(self) -> Mapping[ArtifactKind, ArtifactRef]:
        """Return stale outputs retained for explicit audit/recovery only."""

        return dict(self._stale_artifacts)

    def snapshot(self) -> ApplicationSnapshot:
        """Return the current state without exposing payloads or secrets."""

        return ApplicationSnapshot(
            project_id=self.manifest.project_id,
            status=self.status,
            completed_stages=self.completed_stages,
            readiness=self.readiness(),
            results=self.results,
            adapter_invocations=self.adapter_invocations,
            stale_artifact_ids=tuple(sorted(ref.artifact_id for ref in self._stale_artifacts.values())),
        )

    def cancel(self) -> ApplicationSnapshot:
        """Cancel a planned/running/partial run without deleting artifacts."""

        if self.status is RunStatus.COMPLETED:
            raise ApplicationStateError("completed application cannot be canceled")
        self.status = RunStatus.CANCELED
        return self.snapshot()

    def mark_stale(self, reason: str = "upstream_artifact_changed") -> ApplicationSnapshot:
        """Mark the run stale; stale artifacts remain inspectable but not fresh."""

        if not str(reason).strip():
            raise ValueError("stale reason must not be empty")
        for kind, artifact in tuple(self._artifacts.items()):
            if kind is ArtifactKind.PROJECT_MANIFEST:
                continue
            self._stale_artifacts[kind] = artifact.with_state(ArtifactState.STALE)
            del self._artifacts[kind]
        for stage_id, result in tuple(self._results.items()):
            if result.output is not None and result.output.kind is not ArtifactKind.PROJECT_MANIFEST:
                self._results[stage_id] = replace(
                    result,
                    status=RunStatus.STALE,
                    output=self._stale_artifacts.get(result.output.kind, result.output.with_state(ArtifactState.STALE)),
                    reason=reason,
                )
        self._completed.clear()
        self._stale_reason = reason
        # A stale run is never executable until the caller explicitly resumes
        # it.  This is intentionally true even when it was already canceled.
        self.status = RunStatus.STALE
        return self.snapshot()

    def resume(self) -> ApplicationSnapshot:
        """Resume a canceled/stale/partial run without inventing outputs."""

        if self.status not in {
            RunStatus.CANCELED,
            RunStatus.STALE,
            RunStatus.PARTIAL,
            RunStatus.WAITING_FOR_DATA,
            RunStatus.WAITING_FOR_USER,
        }:
            return self.snapshot()
        self._stale_reason = None
        self.status = RunStatus.RUNNING if self._completed else RunStatus.PLANNED
        return self.snapshot()

    def retry(self, stage_id: str | None = None) -> ApplicationSnapshot:
        """Explicitly recover one failed stage and its downstream consumers.

        Retry is deliberately a user/application action, never an automatic
        response to a failed adapter.  Upstream verified artifacts remain
        available; the failed stage and every dependent stage lose their
        active outputs, while previous outputs are retained as stale audit
        records.  The next :meth:`execute` or :meth:`execute_ready` call is the
        only operation that may publish a replacement artifact.
        """

        if self.status not in {RunStatus.FAILED, RunStatus.PARTIAL}:
            raise ApplicationStateError(
                f"explicit retry is only available after a failed or partial run, got {self.status.value}"
            )
        failed = tuple(
            result.stage_id
            for result in self._results.values()
            if result.status in {RunStatus.FAILED, RunStatus.PARTIAL}
        )
        if stage_id is None:
            if len(failed) != 1:
                raise ApplicationStateError(
                    "retry requires an explicit stage_id when zero or multiple failed stages are recorded"
                )
            stage_id = failed[0]
        stage = self.plan.stage_by_id.get(stage_id)
        if stage is None:
            raise KeyError(f"unknown stage: {stage_id}")
        result = self._results.get(stage_id)
        if result is None or result.status not in {RunStatus.FAILED, RunStatus.PARTIAL}:
            raise ApplicationStateError(f"stage has no retryable failure: {stage_id}")

        affected = self._dependent_stage_ids(stage_id)
        affected_by_kind = {
            candidate.output_kind: candidate
            for candidate in self.plan.stages
            if candidate.stage_id in affected
        }
        for kind, artifact in tuple(self._artifacts.items()):
            if kind in affected_by_kind and kind is not ArtifactKind.PROJECT_MANIFEST:
                self._stale_artifacts[kind] = artifact.with_state(ArtifactState.STALE)
                del self._artifacts[kind]
        for affected_id in affected:
            if affected_id == stage_id:
                # Preserve the failed result as the audit record until the
                # replacement invocation succeeds.
                continue
            prior = self._results.get(affected_id)
            if prior is not None:
                self._results[affected_id] = replace(
                    prior,
                    status=RunStatus.STALE,
                    reason=f"retry requested from {stage_id}",
                    output=(
                        self._stale_artifacts.get(prior.output.kind)
                        if prior.output is not None
                        else None
                    ),
                )
        self._completed.difference_update(affected)
        self._stale_reason = f"retry:{stage_id}"
        self.status = RunStatus.RECOVERING
        return self.snapshot()

    def _dependent_stage_ids(self, stage_id: str) -> set[str]:
        """Return a stage and all transitive consumers in deterministic form."""

        affected = {stage_id}
        changed = True
        while changed:
            changed = False
            for stage in self.plan.stages:
                if stage.stage_id not in affected and set(stage.dependencies) & affected:
                    affected.add(stage.stage_id)
                    changed = True
        return affected

    def _stage_inputs(self, stage: StageSpec) -> dict[ArtifactKind, ArtifactRef]:
        """Return required inputs plus any currently available optional ones.

        Optional inputs are part of the same application-owned handoff when
        present.  They are deliberately not synthesized: an absent optional
        artifact is simply omitted, while a present one is validated and
        included in the adapter context and parent identity.
        """

        return {
            kind: self._artifacts[kind]
            for kind in (*stage.input_kinds, *stage.optional_input_kinds)
            if kind in self._artifacts
        }

    def ready_batches(self) -> tuple[tuple[str, ...], ...]:
        """Return deterministic parallel-group batches without executing them.

        A batch is a scheduling projection only.  Adapters are still invoked
        through :meth:`execute`, so application state is committed by one
        owner and a partial/failed child cannot be mistaken for a completed
        batch.
        """

        groups = self.ready_parallel_groups()
        return tuple(
            tuple(stage.stage_id for stage in stages)
            for _, stages in sorted(groups.items(), key=lambda item: item[0])
        )

    def register_adapter(
        self,
        stage_id: str,
        adapter: StageAdapter,
        *,
        metadata: Mapping[str, str] | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        if stage_id not in self.plan.stage_by_id:
            raise KeyError(f"unknown stage: {stage_id}")
        if stage_id in self._adapters:
            raise ValueError(f"adapter already registered: {stage_id}")
        self._adapters[stage_id] = adapter
        self._adapter_metadata[stage_id] = dict(metadata or {})

    def _record_adapter_invocation(
        self,
        *,
        invocation_id: str,
        stage: StageSpec,
        inputs: Mapping[ArtifactKind, ArtifactRef],
        output: ArtifactRef | None,
        status: RunStatus,
        reason: str | None = None,
    ) -> AdapterInvocationReceipt:
        metadata = self._adapter_metadata.get(stage.stage_id, {})
        receipt = AdapterInvocationReceipt(
            invocation_id=invocation_id,
            project_id=self.manifest.project_id,
            stage_id=stage.stage_id,
            implementation_id=metadata.get("implementation_id", stage.implementation_id),
            source_owner=metadata.get("source_owner", "application-adapter"),
            entrypoint=metadata.get("entrypoint", stage.stage_id),
            input_artifact_ids=tuple(ref.artifact_id for ref in inputs.values()),
            source_snapshot_ids=tuple(sorted({ref.source_snapshot_id for ref in inputs.values()})),
            output_artifact_id=output.artifact_id if output is not None else None,
            output_kind=output.kind.value if output is not None else None,
            status=status,
            reason=reason,
        )
        self._adapter_invocations.append(receipt)
        return receipt

    def adopt_verified_artifact(self, artifact: ArtifactRef, *, stage_id: str | None = None) -> StageRunResult:
        """Hydrate one verified output during an explicit resume operation.

        Resumption may consume a durable artifact receipt, but it may not
        bypass the plan's kind/project/schema/state/parent checks or invent a
        completion marker.  A caller can provide ``stage_id`` when a kind is
        intentionally produced by a custom plan; otherwise the output kind
        must identify one stage unambiguously.
        """

        if self.status in {RunStatus.CANCELED, RunStatus.STALE, RunStatus.FAILED}:
            raise ApplicationStateError(
                f"application is {self.status.value}; call resume or retry before adopting an artifact"
            )
        matches = [stage for stage in self.plan.stages if stage.output_kind is artifact.kind]
        if stage_id is not None:
            stage = self.plan.stage_by_id.get(stage_id)
            if stage is None:
                raise KeyError(f"unknown stage: {stage_id}")
            if stage.output_kind is not artifact.kind:
                raise ValueError("stage_id output kind does not match artifact kind")
        elif len(matches) != 1:
            raise ValueError("artifact kind does not identify exactly one stage")
        else:
            stage = matches[0]

        # Validate the durable reference before looking at current readiness so
        # a wrong-project/schema artifact produces the precise handoff error,
        # rather than being hidden behind a missing-input error for its stage.
        adapter_metadata = self._adapter_metadata.get(stage.stage_id, {})
        base_validation = validate_handoff(
            artifact,
            expected_kind=stage.output_kind,
            expected_schema_version=self.plan.schema_version,
            expected_project_id=self.manifest.project_id,
            expected_producer_id=adapter_metadata.get("producer_id") or None,
        )
        if not base_validation.valid:
            raise ValueError("cannot adopt an invalid artifact: " + "; ".join(base_validation.machine_reasons))

        active = self._artifacts.get(artifact.kind)
        if active is not None:
            if (
                active.artifact_id == artifact.artifact_id
                and active.content_digest == artifact.content_digest
                and active.schema_version == artifact.schema_version
            ):
                # Idempotent replay of the exact same durable reference is
                # safe, but it still must not overwrite a different active
                # payload under the same artifact kind.
                return self._results.get(
                    stage.stage_id,
                    StageRunResult(stage.stage_id, RunStatus.COMPLETED, output=active),
                )
            raise ValueError(
                f"active artifact already exists for {artifact.kind.value}; explicit stale/retry is required"
            )

        # The output may only be resumed after all of its declared inputs are
        # currently admitted.  This prevents a parentless or stale cache file
        # from becoming a completed stage merely because its own state says
        # ``verified``.
        readiness = self.stage_readiness(stage.stage_id)
        if not readiness.ready:
            raise StageBlockedError(readiness)
        inputs = self._stage_inputs(stage)
        input_snapshot_ids = {ref.source_snapshot_id for ref in inputs.values()}
        input_snapshot_id = next(iter(input_snapshot_ids)) if len(input_snapshot_ids) == 1 else None
        expected_output_snapshot_id = (
            None if stage.output_kind is ArtifactKind.SOURCE_SNAPSHOT else input_snapshot_id
        )
        validation = validate_handoff(
            artifact,
            expected_source_snapshot_id=expected_output_snapshot_id,
            expected_parent_artifact_ids=tuple(ref.artifact_id for ref in inputs.values()),
        )
        if not validation.valid:
            raise ValueError("cannot adopt an invalid artifact: " + "; ".join(validation.machine_reasons))
        self._artifacts[artifact.kind] = artifact
        self._completed.add(stage.stage_id)
        result = StageRunResult(stage.stage_id, RunStatus.COMPLETED, output=artifact)
        self._results[stage.stage_id] = result
        self.status = RunStatus.COMPLETED if self._all_stages_completed() else RunStatus.RUNNING
        return result

    def readiness(self) -> tuple[StageReadiness, ...]:
        return self.plan.readiness(self._artifacts, completed_stages=self._completed)

    def _all_stages_completed(self) -> bool:
        """Return whether the active artifact graph satisfies the whole plan.

        ``project_manifest`` is seeded as an application-owned verified
        artifact, so it is intentionally not added to ``_completed`` until a
        caller explicitly executes that built-in stage.  Completion therefore
        follows the readiness graph rather than counting invocation markers.
        """

        return bool(self.plan.stages) and all(item.state == "completed" for item in self.readiness())

    def ready_parallel_groups(self) -> Mapping[str, tuple[StageSpec, ...]]:
        return self.plan.ready_parallel_groups(self._artifacts, completed_stages=self._completed)

    def stage_readiness(self, stage_id: str) -> StageReadiness:
        return self.plan.validate_inputs(
            stage_id,
            self._artifacts,
            completed_stages=self._completed,
        )

    def execute(self, stage_id: str) -> StageRunResult:
        if self.status in {RunStatus.CANCELED, RunStatus.STALE, RunStatus.FAILED}:
            action = "retry" if self.status is RunStatus.FAILED else "resume"
            raise ApplicationStateError(f"application is {self.status.value}; call {action} before executing")
        stage = self.plan.stage_by_id.get(stage_id)
        if stage is None:
            raise KeyError(f"unknown stage: {stage_id}")
        readiness = self.stage_readiness(stage_id)
        if readiness.state == "completed":
            output = self._artifacts.get(stage.output_kind)
            self._completed.add(stage_id)
            result = StageRunResult(stage_id, RunStatus.COMPLETED, output=output)
            self._results.setdefault(stage_id, result)
            if self._all_stages_completed():
                self.status = RunStatus.COMPLETED
            return result
        if not readiness.ready:
            self.status = RunStatus.WAITING_FOR_DATA if readiness.missing_artifacts else RunStatus.PARTIAL
            raise StageBlockedError(readiness)
        adapter = self._adapters.get(stage_id)
        if adapter is None:
            invocation_id = f"{self.manifest.project_id}:{stage.stage_id}:{len(self._adapter_invocations) + 1}"
            reason = f"no adapter registered for stage: {stage_id}"
            receipt = self._record_adapter_invocation(
                invocation_id=invocation_id,
                stage=stage,
                inputs={},
                output=None,
                status=RunStatus.FAILED,
                reason=reason,
            )
            self.status = RunStatus.FAILED
            self._results[stage_id] = StageRunResult(
                stage_id,
                RunStatus.FAILED,
                reason=reason,
                invocation_id=receipt.invocation_id,
            )
            raise AdapterNotRegisteredError(reason)

        inputs = self._stage_inputs(stage)
        # Readiness checks availability and source-snapshot joins.  Repeat the
        # complete handoff validation immediately before the runner so a
        # caller cannot inject a wrong-project, stale, malformed, or
        # unverified reference into the private artifact map and still reach a
        # legacy calculation package.
        input_snapshot_ids = {ref.source_snapshot_id for ref in inputs.values()}
        input_snapshot_id = next(iter(input_snapshot_ids)) if len(input_snapshot_ids) == 1 else None
        input_issues: list[str] = []
        if len(input_snapshot_ids) > 1:
            input_issues.append("source_snapshot_mismatch")
        for kind, ref in inputs.items():
            validation = validate_handoff(
                ref,
                expected_kind=kind,
                expected_project_id=self.manifest.project_id,
                expected_source_snapshot_id=input_snapshot_id,
            )
            if not validation.valid:
                input_issues.extend(validation.machine_reasons)
        if input_issues:
            invocation_id = f"{self.manifest.project_id}:{stage.stage_id}:{len(self._adapter_invocations) + 1}"
            reason = "adapter input rejected: " + "; ".join(dict.fromkeys(input_issues))
            receipt = self._record_adapter_invocation(
                invocation_id=invocation_id,
                stage=stage,
                inputs=inputs,
                output=None,
                status=RunStatus.FAILED,
                reason=reason,
            )
            self.status = RunStatus.FAILED
            self._results[stage_id] = StageRunResult(
                stage_id,
                RunStatus.FAILED,
                reason=receipt.reason,
                invocation_id=receipt.invocation_id,
            )
            raise ValueError(reason)
        self.status = RunStatus.RUNNING
        invocation_id = f"{self.manifest.project_id}:{stage.stage_id}:{len(self._adapter_invocations) + 1}"
        context = StageContext(
            project_id=self.manifest.project_id,
            stage=stage,
            inputs=inputs,
            configuration=self.plan.configuration,
        )
        try:
            output = adapter(context)
        except Exception as exc:
            receipt = self._record_adapter_invocation(
                invocation_id=invocation_id,
                stage=stage,
                inputs=inputs,
                output=None,
                status=RunStatus.FAILED,
                reason=type(exc).__name__ + ": " + str(exc),
            )
            self.status = RunStatus.FAILED
            self._results[stage_id] = StageRunResult(
                stage_id,
                RunStatus.FAILED,
                reason=receipt.reason,
                invocation_id=receipt.invocation_id,
            )
            raise
        expected_output_snapshot_id = (
            None if stage.output_kind is ArtifactKind.SOURCE_SNAPSHOT else input_snapshot_id
        )
        adapter_metadata = self._adapter_metadata.get(stage.stage_id, {})
        expected_producer_id = adapter_metadata.get("producer_id") or None
        validation = validate_handoff(
            output,
            expected_kind=stage.output_kind,
            expected_project_id=self.manifest.project_id,
            expected_source_snapshot_id=expected_output_snapshot_id,
            expected_producer_id=expected_producer_id,
            expected_parent_artifact_ids=tuple(ref.artifact_id for ref in inputs.values()),
        )
        if not validation.valid:
            receipt = self._record_adapter_invocation(
                invocation_id=invocation_id,
                stage=stage,
                inputs=inputs,
                output=output if isinstance(output, ArtifactRef) else None,
                status=RunStatus.FAILED,
                reason=validation.user_message,
            )
            self.status = RunStatus.FAILED
            result = StageRunResult(
                stage_id,
                RunStatus.FAILED,
                reason=validation.user_message,
                invocation_id=receipt.invocation_id,
            )
            self._results[stage_id] = result
            raise ValueError("adapter returned an invalid artifact: " + "; ".join(validation.machine_reasons))
        self._artifacts[stage.output_kind] = output
        self._completed.add(stage_id)
        receipt = self._record_adapter_invocation(
            invocation_id=invocation_id,
            stage=stage,
            inputs=inputs,
            output=output,
            status=RunStatus.COMPLETED,
        )
        result = StageRunResult(
            stage_id,
            RunStatus.COMPLETED,
            output=output,
            invocation_id=receipt.invocation_id,
        )
        self._results[stage_id] = result
        self.status = RunStatus.COMPLETED if self._all_stages_completed() else RunStatus.RUNNING
        return result

    def execute_ready(self) -> tuple[StageRunResult, ...]:
        """Execute one deterministic pass over all currently ready stages.

        This is the production application surface used by an offline bridge
        or a future desktop worker.  It never supplies missing inputs and it
        does not retry failures.  Independent ready groups are visited in
        plan order; a blocked sibling is reported while other ready siblings
        may still complete in the same pass.
        """

        if self.status in {RunStatus.CANCELED, RunStatus.STALE, RunStatus.FAILED}:
            action = "retry" if self.status is RunStatus.FAILED else "resume"
            raise ApplicationStateError(f"application is {self.status.value}; call {action} before executing")
        results: list[StageRunResult] = []
        blocked = False
        for stage in self.plan.topological_stages():
            readiness = self.stage_readiness(stage.stage_id)
            if readiness.state == "completed":
                continue
            if not readiness.ready:
                blocked = True
                continue
            results.append(self.execute(stage.stage_id))
        if self._all_stages_completed():
            self.status = RunStatus.COMPLETED
            return tuple(results)
        if not results and blocked and self.status not in {RunStatus.COMPLETED, RunStatus.FAILED}:
            readiness = self.readiness()
            self.status = (
                RunStatus.WAITING_FOR_DATA
                if any(item.missing_artifacts for item in readiness if item.state == "blocked")
                else RunStatus.PARTIAL
            )
        return tuple(results)
